blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte could conclude by the end of November, the House’s lead prosecutor said Sunday, potentially bringing to a close months of proceedings that have placed alleged misconduct by the early presidential favorite under scrutiny.
